messages:
maya: Heads-up — on-call just flagged a spike of inspect-mode replays hitting /v1/generate. They saw ~300 replays in 10m and some redaction mismatches. Opening thread to align infra + console UX on safe replay/simulator and sampling exemptions.

joel: Oof. Do we know which routes and tokens are used? We have per-route allowlists but the console breakdown doesn't show 'inspect' flows separately.

anya: We should ship a redaction-simulator in the console so oncall can paste a sanitized sample and see what our heuristics would redact at different severity levels. Right now tests live in staging-only and it's too slow for incidents.

samir: Agree. Proposal for a minimal policy config we can merge today (pseudo):
```json
{
  "sampling_policy": {
    "exempt_routes": ["^/v1/inspect", "^/v1/replay"],
    "exempt_tokens": ["oncall-inspect-*"],
    "exempt_window_secs": 900,
    "scrub_severity": "partial"  // values: "none|partial|full"
  }
}
```
This would be evaluated early in the ingest path to avoid sampling.

praveen: Important: simulator must never persist raw PII. If the oncall paste contains sensitive material we can only operate on ephemeral decrypted blobs in memory and write audit events with hashed placeholders. Need KMS ACLs + ephemeral key usage.

ops-bot: Note: canary feature-flag redaction-simulator created on dev0 (flag: redaction.simulator.internal).

joel: Console UX request — show a side-by-side: original (sanitized sample) vs scrubbed output, plus a small panel listing which heuristics fired (email, credit-card, phone, name-heuristic) and confidence scores. Add a toggle to simulate "exempt-route" behavior so operators can see costs/latency impact.

maya: Decision direction: 1) Build an internal-only redaction-simulator behind team flag (no persistence). 2) Add a per-route "exempt_for_oncall" boolean in sampler rules. 3) Expose a compact telemetry view: simulator_runs, redaction_mismatch_rate, and exempted_request_counts. 4) Require KMS ACL + IAM role to run simulator.

samir: I'll open two PRs: (A) sampler rule schema + evaluator that supports exempt_for_oncall + exempt_window_secs, (B) telemetry counter/histograms for mismatch detection. ETA: PRs by EOW.

anya: I'll prototype the simulator UX — simple textarea, scrub-level dropdown (none/partial/full), run button, results with heuristics table and a "why-not-exempt" log when a route isn't matched. Also include a small cost estimator: "expected tokens logged if exempt" vs "if redacted".

praveen: Add infra todo: create ephemeral decrypt role 'simulator-decrypt' limited to dev-only KMS key and no long-term S3 writes. Also we need to update the incident runbook to forbid pasting live customer PII in global channels.

maya: Assignments: samir -> policy PRs, joel -> telemetry dashboard design, praveen -> KMS/ACL, anya -> console prototype + copy. We'll demo a walkthrough on Wed 11:00.

joel: small implementation note — for telemetry, please include both absolute counts and rate-normalized metrics; otherwise exempted routes will look low-traffic but high-cost.

praveen: also +1 on hashed placeholders in audit events, and track a per-request "redaction_version" tag so we can roll heuristics without losing provenance.

maya: Thanks all. Quick blockers?

samir: one: we need a canonical list of oncall token prefixes. two: need test vectors for edgecases (multipart messages, multi-language names). I'll add to the PR checklist.

anya: I'll add a "fuzzy-match" test set to the harness.

maya: OK. If no objections I'll book Wed slot and mark flag for demo. :thumbsup:

joel: :thumbsup:

ops-bot: reminder — feature flag created in dev, please do not enable in prod until demo passed.

maya: closing for now, will follow up with links to PRs + UX mock next message.
